scripts.test:unit: tsc --noEmit && npm test --workspace=@clawr/frontend && npm run test:unit --workspace=@clawr/backend
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:rwrc
scripts.build:rwrc: rm -rf .typia-temp && ttsc -p tsconfig.typia.json && bun build .typia-temp/rwrc/index.js --compile --outfile dist/rwrc
scripts.build:runtime: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R src/runtime/include dist/include && clang -I dist/include src/runtime/*.c -dynamiclib -fvisibility=hidden -current_version $npm_package_version -compatibility_version $npm_package_version -Wl,-install_name,@rpath/libClawr.0.dylib -o dist/libClawr.0.dylib && otool -L dist/libClawr.0.dylib
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
